claims.statement: Kungfu releases declare an installed agent onboarding pack with machine-readable command and mode metadata, safety boundaries, a deterministic first-value contract and receipt, examples, and verifier coverage.

evidence.description: Machine-readable command catalog and mode maturity metadata.
Complete deterministic CLI surface graph shared by offline Agent capabilities and catalog parity checks.
Exact first-value prompt, bounded result, local Codex qualification, and explicit non-claim contract.
Machine-verifiable receipt schema for the selected intent, safe discovery, minimal outcome, and candidate identity.
Human and agent-readable mode selection rules.
Fact labels and safety boundaries for observed, reported, imported, and remote evidence.
Read-only verifier for installed agent pack completeness and command/doc consistency.
Build-free source-acceptance verifier for surface roots and Human, Agent, KFD-3, docs, skills, GUI, and package consumers.
Local-only three-trial fresh Codex qualification harness that retains sanitized receipts rather than raw transcripts.
Provider-free deterministic CI coverage for aggregate and receipt acceptance, tampering, reuse, and partial-failure cases.
Sanitized three-trial local Codex qualification whose receipts and aggregate root are reverified in provider-free CI.

verification.command: node scripts/verify-agent-pack.mjs && node scripts/check-cli-catalog-parity.mjs && pnpm exec buildchain kfd 2 product-claims check

auditBoundary.scope: The committed agent onboarding pack files listed in this claim and the verifier checks that enumerate required docs, skills, the complete generated CLI graph, command catalog entries, KFD-3 links, safety labels, first-value contract and receipt, package data, GUI hint, and TUI hint.
exclusions: Claude qualification and Codex execution hosted by CI
User-specific bootstrap policy files under local home directories
Runtime data and receipts produced after installation

responsibility.escalation: Downgrade the claim if the pack verifier fails or a new public agent command is added without command catalog coverage.

claims.statement: Kungfu report mode exposes a native Codex goal adapter with a verifiable receipt path, and token-only or unknown cost is represented as unknown rather than fabricated zero-dollar cost.

evidence.description: Codex goal report adapter and receipt verifier CLI implementation.
Codex cost adapter: tokens are reported, dollar cost remains unknown when not provided by the provider.
Cost wire model preserving known/unknown cost distinction.
Report-mode user and agent procedure including Codex receipt verification.
Codex-side report closeout gate instructions shipped in the agent pack.

verification.command: node scripts/verify-agent-pack.mjs && pnpm exec buildchain kfd 2 product-claims check

auditBoundary.scope: The committed Codex report adapter, receipt verifier, cost wire model, report-mode docs, and shipped Codex skill instructions listed in this claim.
exclusions: Provider-side billing pages or private sessions
Future Codex API fields not emitted to the user or agent
Human-entered cost overrides outside the receipt verifier

responsibility.escalation: Downgrade the claim if receipt verification stops binding the run id, work id, goal id, status, and reported usage fields.

claims.statement: Kungfu distinguishes local observed facts from reported, imported, and remote facts in the agent pack and remote-sync command surface instead of silently promoting remote evidence into local truth.

evidence.description: Fact labels for observed, reported, imported, and remote evidence.
Remote-sync mode rule requiring source-scoped import.
Remote add/sync command declarations and mode metadata.
Agent command surface including mode selection and bootstrap status.

verification.command: node scripts/verify-agent-pack.mjs && pnpm exec buildchain kfd 2 product-claims check

auditBoundary.scope: The committed agent safety and mode-selection documents, machine-readable commands catalog, and agent CLI command implementation listed in this claim.
exclusions: Remote host identity outside locally recorded source metadata
User decisions to manually promote imported evidence

residualRisk: Remote evidence freshness and identity depend on the configured source runtime and must remain source-scoped until a later command explicitly promotes it.

responsibility.escalation: Keep this claim downgraded or human-reviewed while remote-sync remains an experimental surface.

claims.statement: Kungfu releases publish one welded Agent Work contract whose current release state is explicitly not-qualified for P17, whose FO1-FO10 debt remains machine-readable, and whose continuity smoke, comparison, and projection claims are evidence-bounded.

evidence.description: Accepted role-separation decision and bounded P17 qualification boundary.
Source, package, KFD-2, KFD-3, and continuity evidence-boundary checks.
Positive profiles and fail-closed smoke-as-FO10, missing-baseline, and animation-without-report cases.
Runtime CLI parity and fail-closed contract-schema checks.
Agent collaboration-interface registration for the work-model query.

auditBoundary.scope: The committed four-role contract, its exact packaged projection, the generic KFD-1 query route, the KFD-3 agent route, and the tests listed in this claim.
exclusions: Complete FO9 installed-artifact and FO10 multi-day release-candidate evidence not yet retained
Matched long-task comparison deferred until a feature-complete release candidate exists
GUI, TUI, Python SDK, and Node SDK conformance not yet complete
Universal applicability to every organization or workflow

residualRisk: P17 remains not-qualified until every FO1-FO10 obligation passes and exact release evidence is bound into the Release Passport.
The one-minute smoke is preparatory only; no long-task comparison result or comparative superiority claim is asserted.

responsibility.escalation: Reject qualification or downgrade the claim if the contract, packaged artifact, KFD-1 query, KFD-3 route, or declared P17 debt diverges.

claims.statement: Kungfu releases publish one closed Work lifecycle inventory in which native runtime components are the only semantic decision owners and C++, Python, Node.js, and Rust are lossless request/result projections with explicit unavailable, degraded, unsupported, stale, and unknown states.

evidence.description: Native runtime authority dispatch, explicit state taxonomy, required request fields, and bypass admission fence.
Closed inventory, raw transport, forbidden fallback, status preservation, and ownership gate.
Installed four-language byte, mutation, error, unavailable, unsupported, and bypass vectors.
Installed C++, Python, Node.js, and Rust SDK qualification against one exact native runtime.
Retained macOS arm64 installed four-language report bound to a clean exact implementation commit.
Accepted one-native-owner and four-language projection decision with explicit non-claims.

auditBoundary.scope: The closed operation inventory, native semantic-owner mapping, raw four-language request/result membrane, explicit state and reason-code vocabulary, conformance-only Python oracles, installed SDK vectors, and exact packaged matrix listed in this claim.
exclusions: Native Work journal operations until their adjacent authority cutover is independently merged and qualified
Availability of operations currently declared degraded or unavailable
Semantic success for routes that only return projected and authorityExecuted false
Platform artifacts not exercised by the retained installed qualification

residualRisk: The retained macOS arm64 installed four-language report proves exact projection and error parity for the implementation commit; other platforms and publication remain separate Release Passport claims.
Native Work journal operations intentionally remain unavailable in this claim; the adjacent Work authority change is not merged or reinterpreted here.

responsibility.verificationOwner: kungfu verify and installed SDK qualification
responsibility.escalation: Reject or downgrade the claim if a client invents defaults, filters unknown fields, remaps native states, writes semantic storage, admits a bypass receipt, or the packaged matrix differs from source.
